provenance.audit: the AST enums of oak-dot, oak-mermaid, oak-plantuml, oak-abc, oak-smiles and oak-mdl were compared field by field with the lowering branches of plotter.input.*

supported.construct: a single non-strict graph
graph id
supported.note: the id names the graph and carries no scene geometry, so it is dropped as a documented no-op

supported.construct: rankdir TB / BT / LR / RL
node statement with label / shape / style
edge statement and chained operands
node [...] and edge [...] defaults, scoped to the subgraph they appear in
subgraph cluster_* with a label attribute
named subgraph declaring rank=same
supported.note: rank=same becomes a SameRank constraint and draws no frame. A braces-only group `{rank=same; ...}` has no id, so it is an anonymous subgraph and stays refused

supported.construct: compass ports n / e / s / w
shapes box / rect / rectangle / square / plaintext / diamond / circle / ellipse / oval / cylinder / note / point / triangle / hexagon / parallelogram / trapezium / star / doublecircle / component
style=rounded on a node
edge style dashed / dotted / bold

approximated.loss: drawn as a box

approximated.construct: node style filled / dashed / dotted / bold
approximated.loss: the node fill comes from the theme and the node outline keeps its theme dash and weight

approximated.construct: compass ports ne / nw / se / sw / c
approximated.loss: folded to the nearest axis anchor
a graph label has no scene carrier

refused.construct: anonymous subgraph, including a braces-only `rank=same` group

refused.gap: downstream has no nested cluster frame

refused.construct: subgraph that is neither cluster_* nor rank=same
directed operator in an undirected graph and the reverse
graph assignment other than rankdir / label
element attribute outside label / shape / style
graph with no nodes and no edges

supported.construct: flowchart / graph with TD / TB / BT / LR / RL
node shapes Box / Round / Stadium / Subroutine / Cylinder / Circle / Rhombus
edge statements with solid / dotted / thick / invisible styles
subgraph with a title

  subgraph group[Group]
    A --> B
  end

supported.construct: classDiagram class bodies with fields and methods
classDiagram relations inheritance / composition / aggregation / association / dependency
sequenceDiagram participant / actor declarations
sequenceDiagram messages with solid / dotted / solid-arrow / dotted-arrow

sequenceDiagram
  participant A
  participant B
  A->>B: hello
  B-->>A: world

supported.construct: stateDiagram / stateDiagram-v2 states, composite states, transitions, and [*] pseudo states
supported.sample:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Busy: start
  Busy --> [*]

supported.construct: erDiagram entities, attributes with PK / FK keys, and crow's foot cardinality on both ends

approximated.loss: inner clusters flatten into the outer frame
the state keeps its own node as the transition endpoint, each region becomes one flat frame titled with the state label, and nested states join every ancestor frame

orientation outside TD / TB / BT / LR / RL
parallelogram / trapezoid / hexagon / double circle / asymmetric node shape

class discarded statements direction / note / style / cssClass / linkStyle / namespace / click / acctitle / accTitle / accDescr / callback / link

sequence discarded statements title / accTitle / accDescr / note / loop / alt / else / opt / par / critical / break / rect / end / activate / deactivate / autonumber / box / create / destroy / link / linkStyle
state discarded statements direction / note / style / classDef / class / click / linkStyle / title / acctitle / accTitle / accDescr
entity relationship discarded statements title / acctitle / accTitle / accDescr / direction / style / classDef / click / linkStyle / note
flowchart with no nodes and no edges

supported.construct: @startuml / @enduml pair with content between them
class / interface / abstract / enum with visibility members
class relations association / inheritance / composition / aggregation / dependency / link
sequence participant / actor with solid / dotted / solid-arrow / dotted-arrow messages and activate / deactivate

activity actions `:text;`, start and stop, decisions with then / elseif / else / endif, forks with fork again and end fork / merge / split, swimlanes |Name| and |#color|Name|, legacy arrow transitions

state declarations, composite states with regions separated by --, transitions, [*] start and end chosen by arrow direction, and the <<fork>> / <<join>> / <<choice>> / <<start>> / <<end>> / <<entryPoint>> / <<exitPoint>> stereotypes
supported.sample:
@startuml
state Idle
state Busy
[*] --> Idle
Idle --> Busy : start
Busy --> [*]
@enduml

supported.construct: component packages, component / interface / [Name] declarations, port / portin / portout, and relations reusing the class relation kinds with multiplicity and label
line comments and /' ... '/ block comments

approximated.construct: multiplicity on a class or component relation end
approximated.loss: folded into the relation label
the spec has no gate primitive, so the label rides the edge leaving the rhombus
drawn as a plain box node because the spec has no bar primitive
the cluster frame keeps the theme colour
the state keeps its own node as the transition endpoint, each region becomes one flat frame titled with the state label, and nested states join every ancestor frame

approximated.construct: state start / end / entryPoint / exitPoint stereotypes
approximated.loss: they share the circle outline because the spec has one circle shape
drawn as a standalone round node because the AST records no owning component
inner packages flatten into the outer frame

refused.construct: deployment / usecase / object / timing / gantt / mindmap / wbs / salt / ditaa / nwdiag / rackdiag / packetdiag / archimate / gitgraph / chart
refused.gap: oak-plantuml builds no AST for these families

refused.construct: class or sequence discarded statements skinparam / note / alt / else / loop / group / par / opt / break / critical / ref / box / title / caption / header / footer / legend / scale / autonumber / newpage / hide / show / left / right / top / bottom / allow_mixing
refused.gap: the class and sequence builders drop these statements, so the whole diagram falls back to its source

refused.construct: activity discarded statements repeat / while / endwhile / detach / kill / partition / note / skinparam / title / caption / header / footer / legend / scale / autonumber / newpage / hide / show / left / right / top / bottom / allow_mixing
refused.gap: the activity builder keeps only actions, decisions, forks, swimlanes, and transitions

refused.construct: state discarded statements note / skinparam / title / caption / header / footer / legend / scale / autonumber / newpage / hide / show / direction / style / left / right / top / bottom / allow_mixing
refused.gap: the state builder drops these statements

refused.construct: state stereotype outside fork / join / choice / start / end / entry / exit
refused.gap: the builder downgrades an unknown <<Name>> to a plain state

refused.construct: component discarded statements database / node / cloud / artifact / folder / frame / rectangle / queue / storage / note / skinparam / title / caption / header / footer / legend / scale / autonumber / newpage / hide / show / left / right / top / bottom / allow_mixing
refused.gap: the component AST models only component, interface, port, package, and relations
includes and macro expansion are resolved before the AST, so the source text cannot be lowered
the source must be exactly one wrapped diagram
lines outside the pair carry no diagram meaning

refused.construct: class and sequence mixed in one source
refused.gap: one source lowers to one family

refused.construct: diagram with no nodes and no edges
refused.gap: an empty scene is not rendered
the refusal keeps the authored line span

supported.construct: tikzpicture environment or its bare body
\draw / \fill / \filldraw with -- polylines
rectangle and circle primitives
node[options]{text} inside a path
standalone `\node[options] at (x,y) {text}`
options dashed / thin / thick / very thick / line width / opacity / fill opacity / fill / color / draw / text
draw on a node strokes its label box
supported.note: the box wraps the label extent plus the default inner sep, a third of the font size. Bare draw uses the enclosing path colour, draw=<colour> strokes the box in that colour

supported.construct: xcolor base colour names black / white / red / green / blue / cyan / magenta / yellow / gray / darkgray / lightgray / brown / lime / olive / orange / pink / purple / teal / violet
scale and node placement above / below / left / right
units cm / mm / pt
